Interface SsDataGridHandler

All Known Implementing Classes:
SsDataGridAdapter
public interface SsDataGridHandler
The SsDataGridHandler interface specifies set of methods that can be used to determine whether or not a given row can be deleted, and operation to be performed before and after deletion or insertion of a record.

      boolean allowDeletion(int row)
      Returns true if the row row can be deleted

      SsTableModel calls this function if the row deletion is requested (if SsDataGridHandler is implemented).

      Parameters:
      row - the row number in data grid.
      Returns:
      returns true is the row can be deleted else false.
